verdict.rationale: The SDK supports subagents for parallel focused subtasks and sessions can fork/branch, giving some primitives for multi-agent composition, but there is no evidence of an explicit graph/workflow builder, conditional branching logic, or loop constructs analogous to a DAG-based orchestration framework. missing for 10: explicit graph/workflow definition API, documented branching/conditional routing between agents, documented loop constructs, and independent evidence of complex multi-step orchestration working in practice.
